shortcomings.title: Room Comparison
shortcomings.issue: No room comparison feature exists. Visitors cannot compare rooms side-by-side.
shortcomings.evidence: No comparison component or API endpoint found. Only individual room detail pages exist.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - visitors can still view individual rooms, but cannot easily compare features.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement a room comparison view with side-by-side feature matrix and price comparison.

shortcomings.title: Add-ons Selection
shortcomings.issue: Add-ons exist in database and admin panel, and are integrated in booking flow, but may not be fully persisted or displayed correctly in all booking scenarios.
shortcomings.evidence: AddOnsSelection component exists and is integrated in booking flow. Add-ons are stored in booking notes as text rather than structured data.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - add-ons functionality works but data structure could be improved for better reporting.
shortcomings.recommendation: Consider creating a dedicated booking_addons junction table for better data structure and reporting.

shortcomings.title: Multiple Payment Methods
shortcomings.issue: PaymentMethodSelector component exists and bank transfer option is available, but full implementation status unclear.
shortcomings.evidence: PaymentMethodSelector exists in ReviewAndPay component. Bank wire payment method is supported. Stripe integration is complete.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - payment methods work but may need verification of all payment method flows.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify all payment methods (Stripe, bank transfer) are fully tested and working in production.

shortcomings.title: Booking Modification Request
shortcomings.issue: No guest self-service booking modification feature exists. Only admin can modify bookings.
shortcomings.evidence: No guest-facing booking modification form or API endpoint found. Only admin EditBookingModal exists.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - guests must contact admin to modify bookings, increasing support burden.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement guest portal with booking modification request form, or add modification request form accessible via booking confirmation email.

shortcomings.title: Booking Cancellation Request
shortcomings.issue: No guest self-service cancellation feature exists. Only admin can cancel bookings.
shortcomings.evidence: No guest-facing cancellation form or API endpoint found. Only admin cancellation functionality exists.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - guests must contact admin to cancel, potentially missing cancellation deadlines.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement guest cancellation request form accessible via booking confirmation email or guest portal.

shortcomings.title: Page Load Performance
shortcomings.issue: Performance monitoring exists but optimization is ongoing. LCP, FID, CLS metrics may not meet targets.
shortcomings.evidence: Next.js Image component used, code splitting implemented, but no performance monitoring results found.
shortcomings.impact: High impact - slow page loads can lead to user abandonment and poor SEO rankings.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement performance monitoring (Lighthouse CI, Web Vitals) and optimize based on metrics.

shortcomings.title: Accessibility Compliance
shortcomings.issue: Skip-to-content exists, but full WCAG 2.1 AA compliance audit not complete.
shortcomings.evidence: No automated accessibility testing found. Skip-to-content link exists but full audit needed.
shortcomings.impact: High impact - accessibility issues can exclude users and create legal compliance risks.
shortcomings.recommendation: Run automated accessibility audit (axe-core, Lighthouse) and fix identified issues. Implement keyboard navigation testing.

shortcomings.title: XML Sitemap
shortcomings.issue: Sitemap generation exists but may need verification of completeness and automatic updates.
shortcomings.evidence: app/sitemap.ts exists and generates sitemap with static pages and blog posts. Verification needed for all pages.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - incomplete sitemap can affect search engine indexing.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify sitemap includes all public pages and test automatic updates work correctly.

shortcomings.title: Password Reset
shortcomings.issue: No password reset functionality exists. Admins locked out cannot recover access.
shortcomings.evidence: No forgot password link, reset endpoint, or email verification found. Only simple password-based login exists.
shortcomings.impact: High impact - admins locked out require manual intervention to regain access.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement password reset flow with email verification and secure token-based reset process.

shortcomings.title: Multi-Factor Authentication
shortcomings.issue: No MFA implementation exists. Admin accounts rely solely on password protection.
shortcomings.evidence: No 2FA setup, authenticator app support, or backup codes found.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - current password-based auth works but MFA would improve security.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement MFA using TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) with authenticator app support.

shortcomings.title: Role-Based Access Control
shortcomings.issue: No role-based access control exists. All admins have full access.
shortcomings.evidence: No role definition, permission matrix, or role assignment found. Single admin password used.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - current single-admin model works but limits scalability.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement role-based access with roles (admin, staff, viewer) and permission matrix.

shortcomings.title: Booking Export
shortcomings.issue: Export functionality may be partial. CSV export may not include all fields or date range selection.
shortcomings.evidence: No explicit export endpoint found. Bulk operations exist but export functionality unclear.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - admins may need to manually extract data for external analysis.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify and enhance booking export functionality with CSV/Excel export, date range selection, and field selection.

shortcomings.title: Send Invoice Email
shortcomings.issue: Invoice email sending may be partial implementation. Email template and delivery confirmation unclear.
shortcomings.evidence: Email service has sendInvoice method, but full implementation and testing status unclear.
shortcomings.impact: High impact - invoices not sent automatically can delay payment collection.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify invoice email sending works correctly and add delivery confirmation tracking.

shortcomings.title: Version History
shortcomings.issue: VersionHistory component exists but full functionality unclear. May not track all changes or allow restoration.
shortcomings.evidence: VersionHistory component mentioned but full implementation and database schema unclear.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - content versioning is nice-to-have but not critical.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify version history functionality and enhance if needed for content restoration.

shortcomings.title: Export Reports
shortcomings.issue: Report export functionality may be partial. CSV/Excel export with date range selection unclear.
shortcomings.evidence: No explicit report export endpoint found. Analytics dashboard exists but export unclear.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - reports can be viewed in dashboard, export is convenience feature.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement report export functionality with CSV/Excel format and date range selection.

shortcomings.title: Cancellation Confirmation Email
shortcomings.issue: Cancellation email may not be fully implemented or automatically triggered on booking cancellation.
shortcomings.evidence: Email service has refund notification but cancellation confirmation email unclear. No automatic trigger found.
shortcomings.impact: High impact - guests not notified of cancellation can cause confusion and support requests.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify cancellation email is sent automatically when admin cancels booking, or implement trigger.

shortcomings.title: Pre-Arrival Email
shortcomings.issue: Pre-arrival email service exists but automation may not be configured or running.
shortcomings.evidence: Scheduled email service exists (lib/scheduled-email-service.ts) and cron endpoint exists (/api/cron/send-scheduled-emails), but cron job configuration unclear.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - guests may not receive pre-arrival information automatically.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify cron job is configured and running (Netlify Scheduled Functions or external cron service).

shortcomings.title: Post-Stay Email
shortcomings.issue: Post-stay feedback email service exists but may not be automatically triggered.
shortcomings.evidence: Post-trip feedback email service exists in scheduled-email-service.ts, but automation status unclear.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - post-stay emails improve customer engagement but not critical.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify post-stay email automation is configured and running via cron job.

shortcomings.title: Admin Notification Email
shortcomings.issue: Admin notification email on new booking may not be fully implemented or tested.
shortcomings.evidence: Email service has sendBookingNotificationToAdmin method, but automatic trigger on booking creation unclear.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - admins may not be notified immediately of new bookings.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify admin notification email is automatically sent when new booking is created.

shortcomings.title: Multi-Currency Support
shortcomings.issue: Currency field exists in payments table (defaults to EUR) but no currency selection or conversion exists in booking flow.
shortcomings.evidence: PaymentModal has currency selector (EUR, USD, GBP) but no conversion logic. Booking flow only supports EUR.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - EUR-only is acceptable for Portugal-based business, but multi-currency would improve international appeal.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement currency selection in booking flow with real-time conversion rates if multi-currency is desired.

shortcomings.title: Deposit/Partial Payments
shortcomings.issue: No deposit payment system exists. All bookings require full payment upfront.
shortcomings.evidence: No deposit amount calculation, balance due tracking, or payment schedule found.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - requiring full payment upfront may reduce bookings. Deposit system would increase flexibility.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement deposit payment system with balance due tracking, payment schedule, and reminders.

shortcomings.title: GDPR Compliance
shortcomings.issue: Privacy policy exists and soft delete implemented, but full GDPR audit may be needed. Data export capability unclear.
shortcomings.evidence: Privacy policy page exists. Soft delete (deleted_at) implemented. Cookie consent unclear. Data export API unclear.
shortcomings.impact: High impact - GDPR non-compliance can result in legal issues and fines.
shortcomings.recommendation: Conduct full GDPR audit. Implement data export API, cookie consent banner, and data deletion request process.

shortcomings.title: Rate Limiting
shortcomings.issue: Rate limiting mentioned in INVESTIGATION_REPORT.json but lib/rate-limiter.ts file does not exist. No rate limiting implementation found.
shortcomings.evidence: INVESTIGATION_REPORT.json mentions rate limiting configuration, but actual implementation file missing. No rate limiting middleware found.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - lack of rate limiting exposes API to abuse and potential DDoS attacks.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement rate limiting middleware for API endpoints, especially booking and payment endpoints. Use libraries like express-rate-limit or upstash-rate-limit.

shortcomings.title: Offline Support
shortcomings.issue: No service worker or offline support exists. Site requires constant internet connection.
shortcomings.evidence: No service worker, offline fallback page, or PWA manifest found.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - offline support is nice-to-have but not critical for booking site.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement service worker and offline fallback page if PWA features are desired.

shortcomings.title: Unit Tests
shortcomings.issue: Jest configured and unit tests exist, but coverage percentage unclear. May not have comprehensive coverage.
shortcomings.evidence: Unit tests exist in __tests__/unit/ directory. Jest configured. Coverage command exists but no coverage report found.
shortcomings.impact: High impact - insufficient test coverage can lead to bugs in production.
shortcomings.recommendation: Run test coverage report and identify gaps. Aim for minimum 80% coverage on critical paths.

shortcomings.title: API Tests
shortcomings.issue: API tests exist but coverage may be incomplete. Error case handling and authentication testing unclear.
shortcomings.evidence: API tests exist in __tests__/api/ directory. Jest API config exists. Full coverage unclear.
shortcomings.impact: High impact - API bugs can break booking flow and payment processing.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify API test coverage includes all endpoints, error cases, and authentication scenarios.

shortcomings.title: E2E Tests
shortcomings.issue: Playwright configured and production verification tests exist, but full E2E test coverage unclear.
shortcomings.evidence: Playwright config exists. Production verification tests exist. E2E test files exist but coverage unclear.
shortcomings.impact: High impact - E2E tests catch integration issues that unit tests miss.
shortcomings.recommendation: Verify E2E tests cover critical user flows: booking flow, payment, admin operations.

shortcomings.title: Visual Regression Tests
shortcomings.issue: No visual regression testing exists. UI changes are not automatically detected.
shortcomings.evidence: No screenshot comparison or visual testing setup found.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - visual regression tests are nice-to-have but not critical.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement visual regression testing using Playwright screenshot comparison if UI stability is important.

shortcomings.title: Accessibility Testing
shortcomings.issue: No automated accessibility testing exists. WCAG compliance validation not automated.
shortcomings.evidence: No axe-core, pa11y, or other a11y testing tools found in test setup.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - accessibility issues can exclude users and create legal risks.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement automated accessibility testing using axe-core or Lighthouse in CI/CD pipeline.

shortcomings.title: Analytics Integration
shortcomings.issue: Internal analytics exist but external analytics (Google Analytics) integration unclear.
shortcomings.evidence: No Google Analytics or other external analytics integration found. Internal analytics dashboard exists.
shortcomings.impact: Medium impact - external analytics provide better insights and marketing data.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement Google Analytics or similar external analytics if marketing insights are needed.

shortcomings.title: Calendar Sync
shortcomings.issue: External calendar events table exists but calendar sync (iCal, Google Calendar) unclear.
shortcomings.evidence: No iCal export or Google Calendar sync implementation found. Calendar events table exists.
shortcomings.impact: Low impact - calendar sync is convenience feature but not critical.
shortcomings.recommendation: Implement iCal export and Google Calendar sync if calendar integration is desired.
